# Google Chrome New Tab Interface

## Window Header

- **Application Name**: Google Chrome
- **System Indicator**: "Activities" on the left side of the header
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 18:05" centered in the header
- **System Notification Icon**: Bell icon next to the date and time
- **System Controls**: 
  - Volume control icon
  - Power button icon
  - Network/Bluetooth icon
  - User account icon

## Browser Tabs

- **Tab 1**: "Settings – Languages" with a gear icon
- **Tab 2**: "New Tab" with a tab icon
- **Tab Control**: "+" button to open a new tab

## Address Bar

- **Placeholder Text**: "Search Google or type a URL"
- **Navigation Controls**: 
  - Back arrow
  - Forward arrow
  - Reload button
- **User Profile Icon**: Blue person icon
- **Update Notification**: "Relaunch to update" button with three vertical dots

## Main Content Area

### Google Logo

- **Logo Text**: "Google" in multicolored letters (blue, red, yellow, green)
- **Logo Position**: Centered on the page

### Search Bar

- **Search Input Field**: 
  - Placeholder text: "Search Google or type a URL"
  - Search icon (magnifying glass) on the left
  - Text cursor (I) indicating active input
- **Search Bar Features**:
  - **Voice Search Icon**: Microphone icon on the right
  - **Image Search Icon**: Camera icon on the right
  - **Trending Searches Dropdown**: "Trending searches" with a downward arrow

### Quick Access Icons

- **Web Store Icon**: 
  - Rainbow-colored icon
  - Label: "Web Store"
- **Add Shortcut Icon**: 
  - Plus sign icon
  - Label: "Add shortcut"

## Sidebar

- **Application Icons**:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird Mail
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help Icon
  - Trash Icon

## Footer

- **Customize Button**: 
  - "Customise Chrome" with a pencil icon
  - Located in the bottom right corner

## Navigation and Utility

- **Google Apps Menu**: 
  - "Gmail" and "Images" links
  - Google Apps grid icon (9 dots) on the right
- **System Menu**: 
  - Three vertical dots for additional options
  - Located next to the "Relaunch to update" button
